# Stampede Bar & Grill

> Family-owned restaurant and country bar in downtown Livermore, California, serving lunch, dinner and late-night bites, with live country music every Friday and Saturday night and mechanical bull riding.

- Address: 1790 First Street, Livermore, CA 94550
- Phone: (925) 200-8783
- Email: info@stampedelivermore.com
- Website: https://stampedelivermore.com

## Hours

- Monday – Tuesday: Closed
- Wednesday: 11:30 am – 9:00 pm
- Thursday: 11:30 am – 12:00 am
- Friday – Saturday: 11:30 am – 2:00 am
- Sunday: 9:30 am – 8:00 pm (during football season)

## Food and drink

- Lunch (11:30 am – 3 pm), dinner, late-night bites and dessert
- Food menu: appetizers, soups & salads, sandwiches, burgers, steaks and entrées, sides, dessert and a kids menu
- Signature items include the Tri-Tip Sandwich, The Stampede Burger, Outlaw BBQ Burger, Loaded Spud Nachos, Chicken Wangs (Spicy Honey, Buffalo, BBQ, Mango Habanero or Parmesan Garlic), New York Steak, Prime Rib and Half Rack BBQ Ribs
- House cocktails, buckshots, blended drinks, alcohol-free drinks, wine and a rotating draft beer list
- Options for all dietary needs; ask your server for recommendations
- Delivery through DoorDash

## Good to know

- Everyone is welcome every day we are open. On Fridays and Saturdays, guests must be 21 or older after 8 PM when live bands play.
- $10 cover on nights with dancing; cover may be waived for groups dining with us.
- An event every day we're open, and live music every Friday and Saturday night, mainly country bands with some classic rock.
- Mechanical bull riding.
- Reservations are encouraged: call (925) 200-8783 (tables can be booked up to 6:30 PM on Friday/Saturday) or email a few days in advance.
- No pets; service animals are always welcome.
- The Boar's Nest private saloon: up to 25 guests, dancing and up to 25 bull rides included, no cover charge. Daytime 11:30 AM – 5 PM $250; nighttime 6 PM – 1 AM $500. Book at (925) 200-8783.
- Family-owned with deep Tri-Valley roots.
